#!/usr/bin/env bash
# F3 contract: `doctor` (read-only env-health).
#
#   1. The four carried-over sections (artifacts / submodules / toolchain /
#      runtime) plus the Summary line match `python3 hsim doctor` byte-for-byte,
#      including the exit code, in the ambient (healthy) env.
#   2. MISSING-ARTIFACT: a bogus VSIM_QEMU makes BOTH drivers FAIL the qemu row
#      and exit 1, with identical carried-over output.
#   3. The C++-only engines section reflects F2 discovery: the built-in qemu and
#      a hermetic fake engine both appear under `engines:`.
#
# The C++ driver appends an `engines:` readout after Summary; parity is scoped to
# the carried-over report by truncating at (and including) the `Summary:` line.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
GOLDEN="$ROOT/hsim.py"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"

# The carried-over report = every line through the `Summary:` line.
carried() { awk '{print} /^Summary:/{exit}'; }

# 1. healthy parity (ambient env)
g=$("$GOLDEN" doctor 2>&1);  grc=$?
nf=$("$BIN" doctor 2>&1);    nrc=$?
n=$(printf '%s\n' "$nf" | carried)
[ "$grc" = "$nrc" ] || fail "doctor rc differs: golden=$grc new=$nrc"
[ "$g" = "$n" ] || {
  diff <(printf '%s\n' "$g") <(printf '%s\n' "$n") >&2
  fail "doctor carried-over output differs from golden"
}

# 2. missing-artifact: a bogus qemu path -> both FAIL the qemu row and exit 1
bogus=/nonexistent/qemu-xyz
g=$(VSIM_QEMU="$bogus" "$GOLDEN" doctor 2>&1);  grc=$?
nf=$(VSIM_QEMU="$bogus" "$BIN" doctor 2>&1);    nrc=$?
n=$(printf '%s\n' "$nf" | carried)
[ "$grc" = "1" ] || fail "golden doctor should exit 1 on missing qemu (got $grc)"
[ "$grc" = "$nrc" ] || fail "doctor rc differs (missing-artifact): golden=$grc new=$nrc"
[ "$g" = "$n" ] || {
  diff <(printf '%s\n' "$g") <(printf '%s\n' "$n") >&2
  fail "doctor carried-over output differs (missing-artifact)"
}

# 3. engines section reflects discovery (hermetic fake engine via F2)
ENGDIR=$(mktemp -d -t andes-f3.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$ENGDIR"' EXIT
cat > "$ENGDIR/sim_fakeD" <<'OUTER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ "$1" = "--describe" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"id":"vsim:fakeD","type":"vsim","kind":"cycle-accurate","vlen":256,"xlen":64,"triggers":["marker"],"roles":["standalone"],"state":["drain"],"invoke":{"standalone":["{bin}","{elf}"]},"result":"stderr:cycles"}'
  exit 0
fi
exit 1
OUTER
chmod +x "$ENGDIR/sim_fakeD"

out=$(ANDESIM_ENGINES_DIR="$ENGDIR" "$BIN" doctor 2>&1)
echo "$out" | grep -q "^engines:" \
  || fail "doctor missing engines section:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -qw "qemu64" \
  || fail "doctor engines: built-in qemu64 absent"
echo "$out" | grep -q "vsim:fakeD" \
  || fail "doctor engines: fake engine not reflected (F2):"$'\n'"$out"

# 4. mmap tiers section (C++-only, after Summary like engines): both default
# tiers with free space; HSIM_MMAP_DIR collapses it to the single pinned dir.
out=$("$BIN" doctor 2>&1)
echo "$out" | grep -q "^mmap tiers:" \
  || fail "doctor missing mmap tiers section:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "/dev/shm" || fail "mmap tiers: /dev/shm row absent"
echo "$out" | grep -q "andesim.*free:" \
  || fail "mmap tiers: cache tier row with free space absent:"$'\n'"$out"

PIN=$(mktemp -d -t andes-doctor-pin.XXXXXX)
out=$(HSIM_MMAP_DIR="$PIN" "$BIN" doctor 2>&1)
echo "$out" | grep -q "HSIM_MMAP_DIR" \
  || fail "mmap tiers: pinned dir not reflected:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | sed -n '/^mmap tiers:/,/^[^ ]/p' | grep -q "\.cache/andesim" \
  && fail "mmap tiers: pin should hide the default tier list:"$'\n'"$out"
rm -rf "$PIN"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# F3 contract: `doctor` (read-only env-health).
#
#   1. doctor prints the four sections (artifacts / submodules / toolchain /
#      runtime) plus a Summary line; a healthy tree (no FAIL row) exits 0.
#   2. MISSING-ARTIFACT: a bogus VSIM_QEMU makes the qemu row FAIL and doctor
#      exit 1 -- the exit code is 1 iff any FAIL row.
#   3. The C++-only engines section (printed after Summary) reflects F2
#      discovery: the built-in qemu and a hermetic fake engine both appear
#      under `engines:`.
#
# Golden-free smoke test, run manually during driver development. Not wired into
# run_e2e.sh.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"

# 1. section structure + healthy exit code
out=$("$BIN" doctor 2>&1); rc=$?
for sec in artifacts submodules toolchain runtime Summary; do
  echo "$out" | grep -q "^$sec:" || fail "doctor missing '$sec:' section:"$'\n'"$out"
done
# exit code is a pure function of the FAIL count: no FAIL row => exit 0.
if echo "$out" | grep -q "0 FAIL"; then
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "doctor with no FAIL row should exit 0, got $rc"
fi

# 2. missing-artifact: a bogus qemu path -> the qemu row FAILs and doctor exits 1
out=$(VSIM_QEMU=/nonexistent/qemu-xyz "$BIN" doctor 2>&1); rc=$?
echo "$out" | grep -q "\[FAIL\] qemu" \
  || fail "bogus VSIM_QEMU should FAIL the qemu row:"$'\n'"$out"
[ "$rc" -eq 1 ] || fail "doctor should exit 1 on a FAIL row, got $rc"

# 3. engines section reflects discovery (hermetic fake engine via F2)
ENGDIR=$(mktemp -d -t andes-f3.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$ENGDIR"' EXIT
cat > "$ENGDIR/sim_fakeD" <<'OUTER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ "$1" = "--describe" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"id":"vsim:fakeD","type":"vsim","kind":"cycle-accurate","vlen":256,"xlen":64,"triggers":["marker"],"roles":["standalone"],"state":["drain"],"invoke":{"standalone":["{bin}","{elf}"]},"result":"stderr:cycles"}'
  exit 0
fi
exit 1
OUTER
chmod +x "$ENGDIR/sim_fakeD"

out=$(ANDESIM_ENGINES_DIR="$ENGDIR" "$BIN" doctor 2>&1)
echo "$out" | grep -q "^engines:" \
  || fail "doctor missing engines section:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -qw "qemu" \
  || fail "doctor engines: built-in qemu absent:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "vsim:fakeD" \
  || fail "doctor engines: fake engine not reflected (F2):"$'\n'"$out"
